To honor this [Juneteenth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juneteenth) I decided to run from the office to [Lincoln Park](<https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lincoln_Park_(Seattle)>) in West Seattle: distance 13.8mi moving time 2:27:38 pace 10'42"/mi.

It was also a day for the World Cup: [US vs Australia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_FIFA_World_Cup_Group_D#United_States_vs_Australia), both playing the second game. Seattle was buzzing with people from all over the world: parade, music, just a high level of energy everywhere!

(the choppers flying formation back and forth a few times, probably for the game)

Weather was pretty warm: felt like 75F with 2.2mph wind. Luckily the sun was not as menacing as expected. [Alki beach](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alki_Beach_Park) was surprisingly calm -- people probably all flooded downtown for the game!

After an 8mi run I stopped at Alki beach park to have my favorite clam chowder cup soup for a light lunch, then continued on.

There were swimming meets at [Colman Pool](https://www.seattle.gov/parks/pools/colman-pool). I also finally found the troll: her name is [Bruun Idun](https://www.thomasdambo.com/works/bruun-idun) -- a young teenage troll who plays her flute to the orca whales!

On the bus back, the riders broke into cheers when someone announced that the US had just won the game 2–0! ⚽️

Here's a [video recap](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2nyN2Ln308g) of today's run from Seattle to Lincoln Park to honor Juneteenth.
